about: Written by course staff for the worked example. The scenario is synthetic. Expectations come from the SOP text (references/sop_text.md) and scripts/rules.py, checked by hand.
should_load: It's 7:30 the morning after the hurricane came through Pinellas. ATMS shows 7 red signals on US-19 and we have two generators out. What should the District 7 signal team do over the next 12 hours?
We put a generator on a dark signal at 06:10. Under the D7 signal SOP, when does it need fuel?
Can District 7 still issue an emergency task work order on November 9 if the governor's executive order runs through November 8?
Half the lights on our corridor are dark after the storm and we need to top off the backup power units. What does our SOP say to do first?
should_not_load: What yellow change interval should I use for a 45 mph approach with a 2% downgrade?
Summarize what the Sarasota County 2024 hurricane after-action report recommends about debris management.
Set up a SUMO simulation of a 31-signal arterial and report average delay by intersection.
Write a short public message reminding drivers to treat a dark traffic signal as a four-way stop.

tasks.prompt: Read the attached scenario. What should the signal team do over the next 12 hours? Give me action cards, and tell me what the SOP can't answer.
expectations: Every card cites an SOP clause by id with the SOP's exact words, and python3 scripts/check_cards.py passes on the cards (no FAIL lines).
The first refuel times are 12:10 for NH-114 and 12:40 for NH-121 (six hours after deployment, Immediately Post Storm 3.2.1); later refuels are left to a fueling schedule a person sets (3.2).
Which red signals get the next generators is left to TMC personnel (Three Hours Prior 2.2); the answer does not rank the intersections itself.
No zone names, priority intersection lists, phone numbers or contacts are invented; the answer says Appendix B or C is blank where it matters.
The answer ends with a Not covered list.

tasks.prompt: The Governor's executive order runs through 2026-11-08. Can we issue an emergency TWO on November 9 for signal repairs? Answer with an action card.
expectations: Answers no: an emergency TWO on 2026-11-09 comes after the executive order expires (TWO > Emergency TWOs > 12, a must), the result of python3 scripts/rules.py two 2026-11-09 2026-11-08.
Quotes TWO > Emergency TWOs > 12 word for word: "Do not issue emergency TWO after expiration of governor’s executive order."
Does not invent a workaround as if it were in the SOP (for example an extension); if it mentions extensions, it says a person must confirm them (TWO 1 says to obtain any extensions).

tasks.prompt: Read the attached scenario. Two more signals just went red: US-19 @ Sunset Point Rd and US-19 @ Belleair Rd. Both of our generators are already out. What do we do?
expectations: Stop control at major intersections when no generator can power a signal appears as a Suggestion that cites L1, never as an SOP card or with an SOP field or weight.
Every suggestion says Person decides: yes and names who (TMC personnel with the maintaining agency for L1).
Generator priority stays with TMC personnel (Three Hours Prior 2.2); the answer does not decide which signal loses its generator.
python3 scripts/check_cards.py passes on the cards and suggestions.
